CITY OF LA VERNE

  ADJOURNED MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Robin Carder, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Muir Davis, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Tuesday, February 16, 2021, 5:00 p.m.

Tonight’s Council Study Session will be closed to the public in compliance with Governor Newsom’s Executive
Order to minimize the spread of the COVID-19 Virus. The City encourages public participation in the study
session and offers the following options which are available for the public to participate.

1. Individuals can email their comments to the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org by noon on the
  day of the meeting. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance of the City Council meeting
  and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised that public comments submitted by
  emails or any other format to the City Clerk and City Council are public records and will be made
  available for public viewing.

2. Individuals who wish to share their comments directly during the meeting may do so by emailing the
  Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org with their phone number and the item(s) they wish to
  speak on. Requests will be accepted before and throughout the meeting and staff will call you back at the
  appropriate time. Once items are considered by the City Council, no further public comment on that matter
  will be accepted. A time limit of 3-minutes is set for all public comments.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification or
accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726
at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of every month.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  2.  ROLL CALL: Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis, Mayor
  Pro Tem Carder and Mayor Hepburn.
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Meeting, Tuesday, February 16, 2021, Page 2

3.  Council Study Session - The City Council will meet in study session for a presentation on financing
  options for projects in the Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District.

 4. ADJOURNMENT

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING of the La Verne City Council
  is scheduled for tonight, February 16, 2021, at 6:30 p.m.

  The La Verne City Council thanks the community
  for taking all the precautions to prevent the spread of COVID-19.

  Posting Statement: On February 9, 2021,a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the
  bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
  cityoflaverne.org.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED  MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE
  Tuesday, February 16, 2021

1.  In order to minimize the spread of the COVID- 19 Virus, Governor Newsom issued an Executive Order that
  temporarily  suspends  requirements  of the  Brown Act.  The Council Chambers was closed to the public, La Verne
  City Council Members attended this meeting telephonically, and meeting was live streamed on the City' s website.
2.  A regular meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 5: 00 p. m.
3.  Council  Members  present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Robin Carder
  Council Member Muir Davis
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  Deputy City Attorney Peter Wallin
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer

4.  Conflict  of Interest/  Davis  Prior to the study session commencing, Council Member Davis declared a
  Council  Study Session  on  conflict of interest on this matter because he has an ownership interest in
  Enhanced  Infrastructure  properties located at 2411 and 2425 First Street within the vicinity of the
  Financing District ( EIFD)  subject property.  He left the Zoom meeting.

  The City Council met in a study session with staff and Consultant Larry
  Kosmont, from Kosmont Transaction Service for a presentation on financing
  options for projects in the Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District ( EIFD).

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment on this matter and waited to for staff
  to check if any was received via email.

  There was none.

  The City Council directed staff to explore financing and evaluate what projects
  may be delayed.  Options that included the City' s participation via either City
  Bond Issuance or a use of reserves to fund projects.

5.  Adjournment at 6: 03 p. m.

  Respectfully submitted,

  2. t  Gl,

  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, CMC
  Assistant City Clerk
